title: Visual Birds Studio
description: VBS is established with a vision and soul to break the stigma of VFX as unreal imagery. To break the mediocrity of special effects, VBS is pioneering in seamlessly merging the real world with the so called unreal. We are based in Mumbai and delivers all sorts of Post production solutions from VFX, CGI integration and DI (Digital Intermediate). Been existing as fresh energy for feature film. Industry, OTT contents, TVCs, documentaries; since 2018.
